title: STNFS v6L: lazy descent, five-vector Krylov passes (block selection and sign once per entry), weight-300 merge: 120.2457

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm of proof.md, DESCENT.md and STORAGE.md returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P (Q=[a]Q0 from two GT logarithms; z=1 handled directly) with success at least 0.3901 (hence at least 0.39) over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5, and all classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^120.2457 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000 instructions); upper-rounded ledger rows sum to 2^120.2456705. Relation collection is unchanged from v5 (9ff4fc85): excess 1.1, theta=2330/8000 sub-region of the 164,000-draw pool on theta=5/16, retained relations >= 2^63.6617 (0.0728 bits = 2.00 pool SE above 1.1 U), 99.9% ECM, X2=2^64, slacks (295, 226), band strip, f-first early abort, allowance 1.0174: <= 2^119.9297 units. Linear algebra (v6): Markowitz merge to weight 300 (charged 301 per row; N(300)/N(100) charged 0.711 >= measured maxima 0.690-0.710 at 2^12..2^18), N = 0.711 x 1.066 x 0.05797 U = 2^58.9429 < 8 x 2^56 (eight owners, row tail counted 1,424, charged 1,430), Block Wiedemann (28, 5) with 128-bit X entries; the five Krylov sequences share each pass over the matrix (krylov5.s: 39 instructions per +-1 entry for five vectors, 33 per vector for other entries; block selection 4 and sign 3 once per entry per pass; 12.3 per vector-entry charged), Horner products at 20.7 per entry, 97 per dense term, 420 per reduction, 60 per projection term: <= 2^117.2564 units; generator <= 2^107.8065. Descent (v6): v5's 62-node plan and boot (215, 344, 14, 4), UDUP 0.65, THIN_MAX 85, with lazy evaluation: sieve nodes cofactor their survivors in uniformly random order and stop at the first relation whose subtree succeeds (expected fraction processed <= E_M min(1, (1+1/s)/((1-psi)(M+1)) + psi^M), M negative binomial as in the failure model, checked against a simulation of the process), and the boot finds and descends one relation at a time, at most 18 (Wald: expected (1-psi^18)/(1-psi) relations). Failure events are those of v5. Expected two-log work <= 2^115.6941; meter 2^116.421; Markov abort <= 0.6042008; boot failure 1.573e-03 per log, expected nodes 2^18.24, node abort 2^-9.06, repeats 2^-10.70, 2/r charged. Preprocessing, failures, transfers, verification and output are included; nothing amortized; memory at most 2^105 bytes. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, nonzero lower/upper integration controls, and the lazy-cofactorisation bound against a simulation. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) at relation excess 1.1 (default; optional 'excess') to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).

Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger (recentred kernels, early abort, weight-300 LA with five-vector Krylov kernels, eight-owner row tail), retention, ECM, lazy descent (with a simulation of the lazy process) and declared bounds (about 125 s natively; longer when emulated).
